keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Own Goal by Mike Maignan, AC Milan. Olympiakos 1, AC Milan 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Panagiotis Retsos (Olympiakos).
Delay in match (AC Milan).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Koni De Winter (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Jota Silva (Olympiakos) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Olympiakos 1, AC Milan 0.
Substitution, AC Milan. Yunus Musah replaces Pervis Estupiñán.
Substitution, AC Milan. Christian Pulisic replaces Gonçalo Ramos.
Second Half begins Olympiakos 1, AC Milan 0.
Goal! Olympiakos 2, AC Milan 0. Jota Silva (Olympiakos) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Remo Freuler.
Substitution, AC Milan. Fikayo Tomori replaces Koni De Winter.
Goal! Olympiakos 2, AC Milan 1. Omari Hutchinson (AC Milan) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Remo Freuler (Olympiakos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Panagiotis Retsos (Olympiakos) is shown the yellow card.
Sankhoun Diawara (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Olympiakos 2, AC Milan 2. Alphadjo Cisse (AC Milan) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Omari Hutchinson with a cross.
Substitution, AC Milan. Filippo Terracciano replaces Sankhoun Diawara.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Manolis Saliakas replaces Marcus Pedersen.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Roman Yaremchuk replaces Armando González.
Goal! Olympiakos 2, AC Milan 3. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Omari Hutchinson with a cross.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Konstantinos Fortounis replaces Gelson Martins.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Paschalis Toufakis replaces Panagiotis Retsos.
Substitution, Olympiakos. Nayair Tiknizyan replaces Bruno Onyemaechi.
Substitution, AC Milan. Christian Comotto replaces Alphadjo Cisse.
Goal! Olympiakos 2, AC Milan 4. Diego Moreira (AC Milan) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Christian Pulisic following a fast break.
